name: knowledge-mcp
description: Retrieval agent (reference peer in the registry, not deployed in this replica). It answers 'has this happened before, and what did we do?' by running retrieval-augmented generation over the ServiceNow and Confluence knowledge base: past incidents, known-error articles, and runbooks. Olly and the triage agent call it as a peer for grounding. Unlike Olly, it queries no live telemetry and proposes no RCA; it returns cited prior art. It runs a larger context model tuned for grounded synthesis with citations.

skills.name: Retrieve prior incidents and runbooks
skills.description: Given a service and a symptom, retrieve the most relevant past incidents, known-error articles, and runbook steps from ServiceNow and Confluence, and return an LLM synthesis with citations back to each source document. Read-only over the knowledge corpus; it grounds other agents, it does not act.
examples: {"service": "Card Payments & Settlement", "symptom": "settlement worker OOM during EOD batch"}

eems.description: EEMS bearer for role gco-knowledge-read: read-only across the knowledge corpus.
